tables.sql: SELECT owner, table_name, num_rows FROM all_tables WHERE owner = :schema ORDER BY num_rows DESC

columns.sql: SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type, data_precision, data_scale, nullable, char_used FROM all_tab_columns WHERE owner = :schema ORDER BY table_name, column_id

constraints.sql: SELECT c.table_name, c.constraint_name, c.constraint_type, cc.column_name, c.r_constraint_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON c.constraint_name = cc.constraint_name AND c.owner = cc.owner WHERE c.owner = :schema AND c.constraint_type IN ('P','R','U') ORDER BY c.table_name, cc.position

indexes.sql: SELECT index_name, table_name, uniqueness, index_type FROM all_indexes WHERE owner = :schema

plsql.sql: SELECT object_name, object_type, status FROM all_objects WHERE owner = :schema AND object_type IN ('PACKAGE','PACKAGE BODY','PROCEDURE','FUNCTION','TRIGGER','MATERIALIZED VIEW')

dependencies.sql: SELECT name, type, referenced_name, referenced_type FROM all_dependencies WHERE owner = :schema AND referenced_owner = :schema

sequences.sql: SELECT sequence_name, last_number, increment_by FROM all_sequences WHERE sequence_owner = :schema

rowid_usage.sql: SELECT DISTINCT name, type FROM all_source WHERE owner = :schema AND UPPER(text) LIKE '%ROWID%'

scheduler_jobs.sql: SELECT job_name, job_type, job_action, enabled FROM all_scheduler_jobs WHERE owner = :schema

views.sql: SELECT view_name FROM all_views WHERE owner = :schema

all_objects.sql: SELECT object_name, object_type, status FROM all_objects WHERE owner = :schema ORDER BY object_type, object_name

row_counts.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OW_BILLING.<table> (num_rows NULL: no optimizer stats on fixture)
